caption: Mid-battle fog of war transitions recorded as a replay track (#1579). Fog starts off with both units visible; at 0.5 s F7 toggles fog of war on, causing the distant enemy Archers to vanish and displaying the FOG OF WAR indicator on the HUD; the friendly Spearmen advance eastward while fog remains active; at 5.3 s F7 toggles fog off, restoring full battlefield visibility.
